exposure-boundaries.purpose: Clarify which network surfaces require authentication before exposure.
exposure-boundaries.brief: Draw public internet, proxy/tunnel, operator API, A2A, and public plugin webhooks as separate routes. Label authentication boundaries from current source, not a generic all-traffic-lock icon.
exposure-boundaries.alt: A proxy rule and an application credential solve different problems. Public A2A hostname → Card: discovery · /a2a: bearer → Block /app, /api, /metrics; Separate console hostname → HTTPS proxy / optional access gate → App + API still require credentials; Optional plugin webhook → Explicitly allow only its route → Plugin verifies its signature
exposure-boundaries.caption: Keep the agent privately bound. Public plugin routes are deliberate exceptions, not a reason to expose /api.

config-precedence.purpose: Make configuration precedence and file locations easier to scan.
config-precedence.brief: Draw the actual layers from config explain, with direction of overrides and separate box/instance locations. Keep environment variables and secret values out of the image. Link the field tables for exhaustive detail.
config-precedence.alt: Later configured values override earlier layers; nested maps merge and lists replace. 1 · App defaults → 2 · Host configuration → 3 · Agent configuration; Built-in defaults → <box_root>/host-config.yaml → <instance_root>/config/langgraph-config.yaml; Inspect the effective result → protoagent config explain → Read each field’s provenance
config-precedence.caption: Environment rules are field-specific; they are not one universal final layer. Secrets use separate overlays.

a2a-task-lifecycle.purpose: Visualize task transitions without duplicating the full protocol reference.
a2a-task-lifecycle.brief: Replace or accompany the text diagram with an SVG state diagram of the documented states, including input-required and terminal outcomes. Verify transitions against the implementation; retain textual state definitions.
a2a-task-lifecycle.alt: A paused task is not a completed result. SUBMITTED → WORKING → COMPLETED / FAILED / CANCELED; Input needed during work → INPUT_REQUIRED → Follow up in the same context; Reconnect while running → SubscribeToTask → For terminal results: GetTask
a2a-task-lifecycle.caption: Restart reconciliation fails interrupted work but preserves input/auth pauses. Terminal retention is 24 hours.
